rune.explorationremix.on_hit.desc: Fires when you hit a creature with this tool.
Fires on the last swing of a Better Combat combo, or every third hit without it.
rune.explorationremix.on_kill.desc: Fires when you kill a creature with this tool.
rune.explorationremix.when_hurt.desc: Fires when something hurts you while you hold this tool.
rune.explorationremix.on_block.desc: Fires when you block a hit with a shield.
rune.explorationremix.on_momentum_hit.de: Fires when you land a hit out of a sprint, a Dash, a Leap, or a fall.
rune.explorationremix.on_stagger.desc: Fires when your hit breaks a creature's poise.
rune.explorationremix.while_falling.desc: Fires again and again while you fall more than three blocks.
rune.explorationremix.while_sneaking.des: Fires again and again while you sneak.
rune.explorationremix.twice.desc: The next effect happens twice. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.wide.desc: The next effect covers a much bigger area. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.chain.desc: The next effect jumps to creatures near its target. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.delayed.desc: The next effect fires a moment later. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.quiet.desc: The next effect makes no noise that hunters hear.
rune.explorationremix.heavy.desc: The next effect hits with far more force and breaks poise. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.spark.desc: Lightning strikes the target and arcs to creatures nearby. Wet creatures and water carry it much further.
rune.explorationremix.frost.desc: Chills and slows creatures around the target. A wet creature freezes solid, and a heavy hit shatters it.
rune.explorationremix.ember.desc: Sets the target burning. Fire spreads between packed creatures and never burns blocks.
rune.explorationremix.shove.desc: A burst that throws creatures away from you. Anything slammed into a wall takes impact damage.
rune.explorationremix.ward.desc: A brief shield of extra hearts and resistance.
rune.explorationremix.mend.desc: Heals you at once and a little more over a few seconds.
rune.explorationremix.smoke.desc: A cloud hunters cannot see through.
rune.explorationremix.lure.desc: A noise decoy that hunters go to investigate.
rune.explorationremix.leap.desc: Throws you upward. Your next landing is soft.
rune.explorationremix.dash.desc: Throws you forward the way you look. Your next landing is soft.
rune.explorationremix.glide.desc: You drift down slowly for a while.
rune.explorationremix.confetti.desc: A shower of colour and a cheerful noise. That is all it does.
rune.explorationremix.blast.desc: An explosion that breaks layer stone. Debris falls from the ceiling and hurts whatever it lands on. Band stone never breaks.
rune.explorationremix.keen_edge.desc: This tool deals half again as much damage. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.thick_hide.desc: While you hold this tool you take less damage. Stacks.
rune.explorationremix.cats_feet.desc: While you hold this tool, falls never hurt you.
rune.explorationremix.block.no_run: The block sleeps. It only wakes during a run.
rune.explorationremix.block.full: No free slot on this tool. Remove a rune first.
rune.explorationremix.block.hold_tool: Hold the tool you want to work on
rune.explorationremix.screen.woken: Already woken this run. Rearrange freely.
rune.explorationremix.screen.no_run: Dark. Runes only live during a run.
rune.explorationremix.tooltip.vanilla_de: Vanilla enchantments do nothing in this world.
rune.explorationremix.tooltip.empty: No runes yet (%s slots per sentence)
screen.explorationremix.runes.no_run: Not on a run. Runes wake when you pass the first band.
screen.explorationremix.runes.run: On a run, deepest so far: %s
screen.explorationremix.runes.hint: Read-only. Runes are rearranged at rune blocks.
screen.explorationremix.runes.empty: No tools or weapons in your inventory can hold runes.
item.explorationremix.attunement_book.de: Use it on a tool at a rune block. %s runes become more likely in that tool's offers, for good.
run.explorationremix.started: The run begins. Runes and XP last until it ends.
run.explorationremix.going_home: You touch the bedrock shrine. In a moment, home.
run.explorationremix.no_portal: Portals cannot be lit this deep.
run.explorationremix.no_bed: Only a bed under the sky sets your spawn.
run.explorationremix.no_elytra: Elytra do not open below the first band.
run.explorationremix.no_enchant: Enchanting tables do nothing here. Find a rune block.
The run ended when you left.
The run was ended by command.
run.explorationremix.nest_open: The nest is broken. The gate is open.
run.explorationremix.nest_near: Something stirs in the gate's nest.
run.explorationremix.remains_no_run: The satchel holds a book, but it would crumble up here. It waits for someone on a run.
run.explorationremix.remains_found: You find a %s in the satchel.
